## enter(element, [options]) ⇒ <code>Promise.&lt;MotionResult&gt;</code>

**Kind**: global function<br>
**Returns**: <code>Promise.&lt;MotionResult&gt;</code> - Phase status.<br>

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| element | <code>HTMLElement</code> \| <code>SVGElement</code> |  | Target shell. |
| [options] | <code>MotionOptions</code> | <code>{}</code> | Motion configuration. |
